description: Source code defining a class 'QuestionGeneratorNodes' that handles retrieval, generation, validation, and finalization of medical exam questions within an educational tool. The file integrates with AI models, vector stores, image processing, and storage systems.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorNodes
classes.description: Handles context retrieval, question generation, validation, and finalization for medical exam questions, with intelligent caching, similarity checks, and dynamic context handling tailored to difficulty levels.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes AI client, embedding manager, image processor, vector store, storage, and caches.

methods.name: list _get_cached_questions(self, chapter_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches questions for a chapter with caching to reduce disk I/O.

methods.name: float _calculate_question_similarity(self, q1: str, q2: str)
methods.description: Calculates similarity between two questions using SequenceMatcher.

methods.name: list[str] _extract_medical_terms(self, text: str)
methods.description: Extracts key medical terms from text based on capitalization and length.

methods.name: tuple[bool,str] _is_question_unique( self, new_question: str, chapter_id: int, threshold: float = 0.55 )
methods.description: Determines if a question is unique based on string similarity and medical term overlap.

methods.name: list[str] _extract_covered_topics(self, questions: list)
methods.description: Extracts common medical topics from recent questions.

methods.name: _update_chunk_quality_scores(self, chunks: list, score: int)
methods.description: Tracks quality scores per data chunk for prioritization.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] retrieve_context(self, state: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Retrieves relevant context chunks from vector store with intelligent selection based on recent questions and difficulty.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] generate_question(self, state: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Uses GPT-4 to generate a new question with context and image analysis, ensuring diversity and uniqueness.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] validate_accuracy(self, state: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Validates the question's medical accuracy and quality using AI-based prompts.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_citations(self, state: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Finalizes the question, attaches source and validation metadata, and updates quality scores.
